# Statins and cardiovascular outcomes

Statins reduce LDL cholesterol by about 30% in adults at risk (see Fig. 2) [1]. Earlier
trials, e.g. the 4S study, showed lower mortality [2, 3]. The effect on stroke was
smaller (p = 0.03) and limited to J. Smith's cohort [1-3]. Some work reports no benefit [7].

This sentence has no citation. Results in older adults were mixed [2–3].
